internal.title: Incident Report: High Latency in Ad Service Due to Resource Exhaustion
internal.body:
At 10:29 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high latency in the ad service. Investigation identified high CPU utilization (98%) coinciding with increased p95 latency (1.8 seconds). No recent deployments or errors were found. A recent feature flag activation correlated with the onset of the issue. The flag was disabled at 10:49 UTC, resulting in latency returning to normal levels (0.12 seconds). The incident was resolved promptly with no further impact.

Timeline:
- 10:29:36: Alert received for high latency
- 10:49:23: Diagnosis confirmed resource exhaustion due to high CPU
- 10:49:28: Feature flag disabled
- 10:49:28: Latency verified to have normalized

Root Cause:
Resource exhaustion caused by a recently enabled feature flag leading to high CPU usage.

Resolution:
Disabling the feature flag restored normal service latency.

Lessons Learned:
- Monitor feature flag impacts closely on resource usage.
- Establish rapid rollback procedures for feature flags causing performance degradation.
